basis: The chart shows a clear, sustained decline from 23.9°C in 2005 to 10.1°C in 2014, a total change of -13.8°C. This is a significant downward trend over the review period. The routing criterion asks whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up. A drop of nearly 14 degrees over 9 years is a substantial change in temperature, not ordinary variation. The task requires routing based on the dashboard data. The 'substantial-change follow-up' option is the appropriate routing for a change of this magnitude, as it is clearly not 'ordinary variation' and there is no indication to archive the record.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 cooling water temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
